Cryptographers warn that the technology protecting individual privacy may not yet go far enough to stop people from being tracked. Advances in cryptographic techniques since the law was passed in 2024 means this problem could be solved. Spanning 10 days, the expedition yielded no verified sightings of the critically endangered Fiji petrel, one of the world's most elusive birds. Fewer than 50 individuals are believed to remain on Earth.

O sistema de iluminação conta com aberturas de ventilação justamente para equilibrar a pressão e permitir a circulação do ar. O sinal de alerta está na intensidade e na duração do embaçamento. resumo: Since 2022, astronomers have been puzzling over a new kind of cosmic object called long-period radio transients. Some have been traced back to binary systems consisting of a small, dim, cool star called a red dwarf in orbit with a stellar remnant called a white dwarf.

titulo: Personalized therapies for Crohn's and ulcerative colitis may follow from method that identifies harmful gut bacteria
resumo: Which gut bacteria contribute to the development or worsening of chronic inflammation? An international research team led by Dr. Lukas Mager from University Hospital Tübingen and Prof. Kathy McCoy from the University of Calgary has developed an approach to identify and selectively target such bacteria. The researchers identified two bacterial species that promote intestinal inflammation and compounds that selectively inhibit their growth. Published in the journal Gut, the study could pave the way for personalized therapies for inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) such as Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.

titulo: Longer inhibitory connections can push simulated neural networks beyond critical tipping point
resumo: In neuroscience, the brain criticality hypothesis proposes that neurons in the brain are arranged in such a way that neural activity lies at or near a transition point between two extremes: an ordered state where neural activity dies out quickly and a disordered state where neural activity tends to spread quickly and potentially grow uncontrollably. This transition point is known as criticality, while the two activity regimes on either side of it are known as subcritical and supercritical, respectively.

titulo: A single CRISPR infusion lowers blood fats in monkeys for three years

Gene-editing technologies offer a potential alternative to lipid-lowering medications. In a new CRISPR experiment, a single infusion of a gene-editing treatment kept triglyceride levels low in monkeys for three years. The findings support the possibility of controlling blood fats with a lasting DNA change, potentially replacing daily doses of medication.
